**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 sits at (indeed fully satisfies) the preferred position:

- **Frequency:** no more than once in any twelve-month period (§22.1)
- **Notice:** at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, without unreasonable disruption (§22.1)
- **Manner:** off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§22.1)
- **Cost:** Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§22.2)
- **System access:** expressly prohibited — Vendor and its auditor may not access our systems directly, Customer Data unrelated to usage, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information (§22.2)

Section 22.3 adds terms in our favour (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, payment of shortfall resolves the issue). Section 23 ("Records and Customer Assurance") is a bare heading with no substantive text, and a document-wide search for inspection/verification/records/remote-access language surfaced nothing else binding us, so there is no residual audit exposure to close.
